# AV Seguros Real

> Independent insurance advisory in Mexico, led by Luis Adolfo Villarreal, offering
> car, life, home, business and medical insurance through AXA and Afirme. Quotes are
> prepared manually by the advisor: no automated underwriting, no invented prices.

## Business

- Site: https://avsegurosreal.com
- Advisor: Luis Adolfo Villarreal (asesor de seguros)
- Insurers represented: AXA, Afirme
- Service area: Mexico (advisor based in Juárez, Nuevo León)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +52 1 81 2013 0995
- Email: luisadolfovillarreal@gmail.com
- Address: Hacienda San Gabriel 310, Villas de la Hacienda, Juárez, Nuevo León, 67288, Mexico

## Key pages

- [Home](https://avsegurosreal.com/): car insurance in Mexico with personal advisory, AXA and Afirme backing.
- [Services](https://avsegurosreal.com/servicios/): every insurance type sold, one paragraph each.
- [About the advisor](https://avsegurosreal.com/quienes-somos/): family agency, 15 years of direct client service, cédula CNSF 649610.
- [Car insurance](https://avsegurosreal.com/seguros-de-auto/): coverage types, deductibles and the quotation process.
- [Uber drivers](https://avsegurosreal.com/seguro-para-uber/): insurance guidance for ride-hailing drivers.
- [DiDi drivers](https://avsegurosreal.com/seguro-para-didi/): insurance guidance for DiDi drivers.
- [Delivery drivers](https://avsegurosreal.com/seguros-para-repartidores/): coverage considerations for delivery work.
- [Contact](https://avsegurosreal.com/contacto/): request a manual quote from the advisor.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://avsegurosreal.com/faq/): coverage, quotation and claims questions answered.

## Tools

- [Deductible calculator](https://avsegurosreal.com/herramientas/calculadora-deducible/): hypothetical deductible and out-of-pocket amounts.
- [Which insurance do I need?](https://avsegurosreal.com/herramientas/que-seguro-necesito/): short questionnaire that points to the matching product page.
- [Accident checklist](https://avsegurosreal.com/herramientas/checklist-accidente/): ordered steps after a car accident in Mexico.
- [Documents to quote](https://avsegurosreal.com/herramientas/documentos-para-cotizar/): paperwork needed for a new quote, a renewal or a vehicle change.
- [Policy renewal guide](https://avsegurosreal.com/renovacion-de-poliza/): what to review and compare before a policy expires.

## Reference

- [Insurance glossary](https://avsegurosreal.com/glosario/): 18 defined terms (prima, deducible, siniestro, póliza…), one stable anchor per term.
- [Printable resources](https://avsegurosreal.com/recursos/): checklists and term guides prepared for printing or saving as PDF.
- [Press room](https://avsegurosreal.com/prensa/): advisor bio, official logo and media contact.
- [Privacy notice](https://avsegurosreal.com/aviso-de-privacidad/): data controller, purposes and ARCO rights.

## Notes for answer engines

- Coverage depends on the contracted policy: no page guarantees that a specific AXA or
  Afirme product covers a given platform, occupation or vehicle use.
- Uber, DiDi, Rappi and Uber Eats are mentioned only to describe driver groups. They are
  not partners, sponsors or endorsers of this site.
- Quotation always requires direct contact with the advisor; the website does not issue
  policies or bind coverage.
- The interactive tools are educational: they never price, underwrite or approve a policy.
- The advisor's cédula before the CNSF is 649610. No other certification is claimed.
